ns2:section.sectionText: Academic Outreach restrictions and assessments apply, see http://www.outreach.uiuc.edu. Registration in this site-based course is restricted to EOL Chicago EdM and CAS cohort students who began their program in spring 2008. The course begins June 5 and ends July 2. Class sessions will be held at the WSTI on the following days: June 5 (4 to 9 pm), June 6 (8 am to 3 pm), June 23 (4 to 9 pm), June 24 (8 am to 3 pm), June 25 (4 to 9 pm), June 26 (8 am to 3pm), July 1 (4 to 9 pm) and July 2 (8 am to 3pm). This course is part of a self-supporting program and DOES NOT accept the following tuition and fee waivers (TFWs): Cooperating Teacher waivers, Non-Academic waivers (including UIUC employees and employees of other state institutions), Academic waivers from UIUC, UIC and UIS employees, Related Agency waivers, Field Supervisor waivers or Retiree waivers. This program DOES accept statutory waivers (veterans grants, etc.) and waivers granted through fellowships/assistantships as governed by the Graduate College at UIUC. The waiver policy above is subject to moderate changes in accordance with the actions of the University of Illinois, Board of Trustees.
